name: employetics-ad
description: 40-second isometric pastel motion-graphics ad for Employetics (AdTwo — Remotion v4, React + TypeScript)

scripts.still: node scripts/sync_assets.mjs && remotion still src/index.ts AdTwo
scripts.render: node scripts/sync_assets.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts AdTwo out/ad2.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p
